chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Muhammad ibn Hamzah al-Alawi, who said: 'Ubayyidullah ibn Ali informed me, from Abu al-Hasan al-Awwal (peace be upon him), who said:

I frequently heard my father saying: 'He is not from our Shia, the one whose devoutness is not talked about by the women in their coverings; and he is not from our friends, the one who is in a town wherein are ten thousand men, among them is a creature of Allah who is more devout than him'.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of a true Shia according to the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) establishes 'war'' (asceticism/piety) as the definitive marker of authentic Shia identity, emphasizing that true devotion is not merely internal but manifests in a public reputation so profound that even the women of the household testify to it. It further posits a comparative standard, asserting that within any large community, the true friend of Allah will invariably be the most pious, thereby linking spiritual excellence with social recognition in Shia theological tradition.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Saeed, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, from Muhammad Bin Hama Al Alawy who said, ‘Ubeydullah Bin Ali informed me, (It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> the 1<sup style="font-weight: normal">st</sup> having said:

‘I<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> used to frequently hear my<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> father<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> saying: ‘He is not from our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> Shia, the one whose devoutness is not talked about by the women in their coverings; and he is not from our<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> friends, the one who is in a town wherein are ten thousand men, among them is a creature of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> who is more devout than him’.
en.sarwar: 15. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Muhammad ibn Hamza al-‘Alawi who has said the following: “’Ubayd Allah ibn Ali reported to me from abu al-Hassan the 1 st  (a.s.) who has said, ‘

I would hear my father saying, “One of whose restraint from worldly matters (sins) ladies in their private quarters would not speak, is not of our Shi’a, and neither is one who lives in a town of ten thousand people among whom Allah has created someone restraining more from worldly matters than he is.’”
